title: The 3 Best Luggage Under $300
metaDescription: Our 3 picks for luggage under $300, with key specs, strengths and limitations for each, based on manufacturer specs, independent reviews and owner reports.
lede: We looked at luggage under $300 using manufacturer specs, independent reviews and owner reports. Each pick lists what it does well and where it falls short, so you can match it to how you'll use it.

products.name: Monos Carry-On Pro 22-Inch Hardside Spinner
products.blurb: Key specs: 22-inch polycarbonate hardshell, 36L capacity, Padded front compartment fits a 16-inch laptop, 360-degree spinner wheels.
strengths: Front laptop compartment is a real upgrade over budget bags at this price
Highest owner rating in this category at 4.8 out of 5
limitations: Fixed 36L capacity with no expansion panel
22-inch size is on the larger edge of some tighter international sizers
Carry-on only, no checked-size option in the same line
features: Padded front compartment fits a 16-inch laptop

products.name: Samsonite Freeform 24-Inch Medium Hardside Spinner
products.blurb: Key specs: 24-inch expandable polypropylene hardshell, Dual 360-degree spinner wheels, TSA-approved combination lock.
strengths: 8.5-pound empty weight leaves more of the checked weight limit for belongings
limitations: Shell shows scuffs and scratches more visibly than fabric-shell bags
Wheel housings wear faster under heavy repeated use than premium double-swivel designs

products.name: Samsonite Omni 2 Hardside Expandable Carry-On Spinner
limitations: Expanded size may exceed carry-on limits
